BIGBANG10 THE CONCERT 0.TO.10 -THE FINAL- IN JAPAN (1080p HD)​

​

・Before enlisting in the military, this was T.O.P last performance on Japan tour with BIGBANG as full group members!!!
・The celebration tour ran from November to December 2016, where 781,500 people were mobilized in 16 performances in all four cities in Japan!!!
・The enthusiasm and emotion tour final @ KYOCERA DOME OSAKA performance on 2016.12.29 is the complete recording of the show running 183 minutes!!!
